Slots #5, #3, #2, #4, #6, #1, #7, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 2 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.26 expected PA/game vs 4.47 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
